objects.type: (a ⟶ Cont r b) ⟶ Cont r a
objects.tooltip: f — user-supplied function that receives the captured escape (a ⟶ Cont r b) and returns the body's continuation.
Cont r a — same outer type as f's result; control flow may exit early via the escape.
